about.title: About
columns:
PUC-Rio is one of Latin America’s leading universities, recognized for academic excellence, strong industry integration, and international outlook.

SAIL PUC-Rio, the Software & AI Engineering Lab, is part of PUC-Rio's Graduate Program in Informatics, Brazil's first research-oriented graduate program in Computing, recognized with the highest score in the national graduate evaluation system (CAPES 7 - International Research Excellence).

SAIL PUC-Rio is a partner laboratory (Co-Lab) of Instituto Kunumi, being integrated into Brazil’s largest collaborative AI research network. It is also represented in the International Software Engineering Research Network (ISERN).

Embedded in this environment of research excellence, the mission of SAIL is to produce knowledge, educate outstanding professionals and researchers, and contribute to building more effective, reliable, responsible, and human-centered software and AI systems.

In line with this mission, our research areas comprise AI Engineering, AI-Augmented Software Engineering, Empirical Software Engineering, and Human and Social Aspects of Software Engineering.

Guided by a commitment to the collective construction of knowledge, SAIL collaborates with universities, research centers, and industry partners in Brazil and worldwide.

coordination.title: Coordination
coordination.description:
Marcos Kalinowski is the coordinator of SAIL PUC-Rio and a faculty member at the Department of Informatics at PUC-Rio. With over 15 years of experience in software engineering research, he leads initiatives in empirical software engineering, AI engineering, and human aspects of software development.

SAIL Coordination ensures that our research, partnerships, and collaborative initiatives operate smoothly while maintaining the highest standards of academic rigor and real-world impact. Under his leadership, the coordination team works to connect our research community with industry partners, foster collaboration among researchers and students, and translate our findings into practical solutions that benefit both academia and industry.
